ITEM_CONTAINER.Title: Inventory
ITEM_CONTAINER.OverCapacityWarningTitle: The container is over maximum capacity!
ITEM_CONTAINER.WarnNoContainer: No containers have been created to store this item.
ITEM_CONTAINER.WarnNoActorSelected: Please select a single token or assign a character to your user to open the container manager.
ITEM_CONTAINER.DeleteDialog.Title: Delete Container and its Contents
ITEM_CONTAINER.DeleteDialog.Content: This will permanently delete the container "{containerName}" and all items within it. This action cannot be undone.
ITEM_CONTAINER.EmptyDialog.Title: Empty Container
ITEM_CONTAINER.EmptyDialog.Content: Are you sure you want to move all items from "{containerName}" back to the main inventory?
ITEM_CONTAINER.DeleteItemDialog.Title: Delete Item
ITEM_CONTAINER.DeleteItemDialog.Content: This will permanently delete the item {itemName} from the actor. This action cannot be undone.
ITEM_CONTAINER.WarnNoPermission: You do not have permission to view this actor's inventory.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.Title: Inventory Settings
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.ActorTypesHint: Select which actor sheet types the Inventory button should appear on.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.ItemTypesHint: Select which item types should be visible in the Inventory. Unselected items will be ignored.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.MenuHint: Select the Actor and Item types that this module should use.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.WeightPathHint: The path to the item's weight attribute (e.g., system.weight.value).
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.CostPathHint: The path to the item's price attribute (e.g., system.price.value).
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.MinAccessLevelHi: Select the minimum ownership level required for a player to view, open and manage the inventory for an actor.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.compatibilityMod: Forces the rendering of the Counters. If the counters do not appear, try enabling this option.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Keybindings.OpenManagerHi: Opens the Inventory for the currently selected token or assigned character.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.QuantityPathHint: The path to the item's quantity attribute (e.g., system.quantity).
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.UseQuantityHint: If checked, item weight and price will be multiplied by their quantity.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.ShowWeightColumn: If checked, the weight column will be visible in the container manager.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.ShowCostColumnHi: If checked, the price column will be visible in the container manager.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.ShowQuantityColu: If checked, the quantity column will be visible in the container manager.
ITEM_CONTAINER.Settings.AlwaysShowTabNam: If enabled, container names will be visible on all tabs, not just the active one.
